name: Lessons
overview: The Scriptures reveal that lessons in faithfulness, responsibility, and trust in God's justice are essential for the believer's life. Jesus teaches the importance of being faithful in small matters as a reflection of greater faithfulness, while also encouraging preparedness and discernment in daily living. Moreover, believers are instructed to leave vengeance to the Lord, trusting in His righteous judgment. Throughout these lessons, the unchanging nature of Jesus Christ provides a firm foundation for growth and obedience.
